description: Audit and improve the technical and on-page SEO of an existing Progressive CMS site for Google and Yandex, with complete applicable checks, public rendering evidence and no ranking guarantees.
entry_workflow: Confirm target, canonical host, permissions and actual CMS contracts; refresh official engine sources.
Build a URL ledger from CMS, sitemap, links and known URLs, preserving uncrawled remainder.
Fix crawl/indexing/canonical blockers and shared template/head causes before per-page data.
Cover all applicable metadata, headings, links, media, structured-data and performance criteria.
Recheck affected public URLs and external provider evidence; report unresolved scope/capability limits.
